fields.label: Configuration Set Name
fields.help: Name of the configuration set this event destination belongs to.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Whether the event destination is enabled.

fields.label: Matching Event Types
fields.help: Event types for which the destination receives records.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).

fields.label: IAM Role Arn
fields.help: ARN of the IAM role that End User Messaging SMS assumes to write to the log group.

fields.label: Log Group Arn
fields.help: ARN of the Amazon CloudWatch log group that receives the events.

fields.label: Delivery Stream Arn
fields.help: ARN of the Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream that receives the events.

fields.label: IAM Role Arn
fields.help: ARN of the IAM role that End User Messaging SMS assumes to write to the delivery stream.

fields.label: Topic Arn
fields.help: ARN of the Amazon SNS topic that receives the events.
